items.title: Rill Browser
items.name: Rill Browser
items.summary: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
items.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt, I'm William! I made Rill because I want to always stay in the flow.

As an ADHD, I never liked code-switching. My best ideas for work come when I'm supposedly not working at all: watching something for fun, reading things and following a rabbit hole, looking at how someone else solved a problem. Then when an idea hit me, I'd have to stop, switch to coding agents, find the project and explain it all, and most of the time I just didn't.

Rill is my way of removing that code-switching. It's a browser with your Claude Code or Codex working alongside you. When something on a page gives you an idea, you say so right there, and an agent starts on it in the right project. You don't have to spend time looking for the right folder, rephrasing everything you just saw on the web, and you don't switch in and out of work mode. The work goes on with you in the flow.

This matters now more than ever. Agents have shortened the distance between ideas to output near zero. So the bottleneck is capturing the idea at the moment you have it. That moment is nearly always while you're taking something in, and that is what a browser is for.

Rill is a free AI-native browser. It's WebKit-based, which means it's native to Mac. And it runs on the Claude Code or Codex plan you already have, so you don't have to buy a new subscription for all of its agentic capabilities.c

How do you keep an idea today when it shows up at the wrong time?

Congrats on the launch!!

quick question, does the console go across too? i'm usually just looking at my own localhost and the thing i actually need is whatevers in the console, plus the request that failed under it. right now thats me copy pasting it in every time and how does it know which project.

i have the same app running on like three ports half the time.
Hey @williamgaoharvard Congrats on your launch and leading the chart. Is this mobile compatible, can we send tasks from mobile, we could do with Claude?

items.name: Velozity
items.summary: The Multiplayer AI Office where your team and agents work.
items.description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Darshan, co-founder of Velozity.

AI is single-player. Real work is multiplayer.

Everyone on our team was paying for their own AI, and everyone was using it alone. You prompt, copy the answer into chat, explain it to a teammate, get feedback, then prompt again. The AI got faster, but the team didn't.


So we built Velozity, one shared office for your people and their AI agents:

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Live presence. See who's in, knock on a cabin and talk. No links, no invites.
🤖 An agent for every teammate. Agents read the same mail, files and calls your team does, work inside your apps and carry a job through to the end.
💳 Bring your own AI. Agents run on the AI subscription you already pay for.
✅ You stay in control. Nothing is sent, paid or signed without a person approving it.

We run our own company inside Velozity every day. This launch was planned in it, by our team and our agents working in the same space.

It's free to start, and it's far from finished. We'd love to hear where it breaks for your team, not only what looks nice.

👉 Try it here: getvelozity.com

Describe a video and your agent makes it with HyperFrames, then you and your agent work on it together in one studio editor.
top_comments:
Hey PH,

i'm Bin Liu, i lead agentic video product & engineering at @HeyGen

the past 5 months has been absolutely crazy:
- we open sourced HyperFrames: now we have over 56,000 stars on github (https://github.com/heygen-com/hy...)
- we launched HyperFrames skills: now we are ranked 13th most popular skill of all time on skills.sh - and climbing into all-time top 10 very soon
- we integrated HyperFrames into majority if not all agentic platforms: Claude, Codex, Hermes, Grok, Claude Design, and many more.

and today, we are finally launching our first consumer product: HyperFrames Studio - built for founders, marketers, storytellers and their agents.

for those of you who aren't familiar with HyperFrames yet:
HyperFrames lets an agent write a video as HTML and render it to MP4. The hard part is everything after the first draft - describing in chat which word at which second needs to change.

HyperFrames Studio is the editor for that part. Claude Code or Codex builds the video, and you direct it on the frame:
- Draw on the frame - circle the title, write "glow pink, flicker on letter by letter" and the agent makes the edit
- Comment on any element - click a word or a clip, leave a note, then send all your notes at once
- Start from videos that work - we’ve rebuilt the highest performing videos as code to help agents create better videos
- Edit by hand when you want to - timeline, clip speed, and export to MP4, WebM or MOV up to 4K

our HyperFrames core technology is open source: https://github.com/heygen-com/hy...

Studio runs on macOS and Linux, Windows is coming soon: https://hyperframes.dev/studio/d...
Are you planing to make it for images and illustrations?

items.description: The first video editor built for agents - built by the team who open sourced HyperFrames at HeyGen Bring your favorite agent (either codex or claude code), HyperFrames Studio turn your coding agents into video editors, while you stay in the director seat. Describe a video and your agent makes it with HyperFrames, then you and your agent work on it together in one studio editor.
top_comments:
Hey PH,

i'm Bin Liu, i lead agentic video product & engineering at @HeyGen

the past 5 months has been absolutely crazy:
- we open sourced HyperFrames: now we have over 56,000 stars on github (https://github.com/heygen-com/hy...)
- we launched HyperFrames skills: now we are ranked 13th most popular skill of all time on skills.sh - and climbing into all-time top 10 very soon
- we integrated HyperFrames into majority if not all agentic platforms: Claude, Codex, Hermes, Grok, Claude Design, and many more.

and today, we are finally launching our first consumer product: HyperFrames Studio - built for founders, marketers, storytellers and their agents.

for those of you who aren't familiar with HyperFrames yet:
HyperFrames lets an agent write a video as HTML and render it to MP4. The hard part is everything after the first draft - describing in chat which word at which second needs to change.

HyperFrames Studio is the editor for that part. Claude Code or Codex builds the video, and you direct it on the frame:
- Draw on the frame - circle the title, write "glow pink, flicker on letter by letter" and the agent makes the edit
- Comment on any element - click a word or a clip, leave a note, then send all your notes at once
- Start from videos that work - we’ve rebuilt the highest performing videos as code to help agents create better videos
- Edit by hand when you want to - timeline, clip speed, and export to MP4, WebM or MOV up to 4K

our HyperFrames core technology is open source: https://github.com/heygen-com/hy...

Studio runs on macOS and Linux, Windows is coming soon: https://hyperframes.dev/studio/d...
Are you planing to make it for images and illustrations?

curious about the collaboration model here: if I nudge a frame manually while the agent is mid-edit on that same section of the timeline, does my change survive the next time the agent touches that part, or does it get overwritten because the agent is working off its own copy of the HTML rather than what's actually rendered on screen right now

interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是法律 AI 的争论点已经从“能不能替代人审合同”下沉到审到什么颗粒度、依据能否被律师复核，而条文与判决公开这一数据条件正被当成可自建工作流的前提。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是通用模型加现成工具混用——有人直接拿 ChatGPT 类模型处理合同，有人上 Ironclad、律己 AI、幂律智能这类已有商业产品做审查和全生命周期管理，GitHub 上也出现用 LangChain Agent 接法律数据库 API 自建咨询、审查、文书生成的项目，讨论仍集中在“AI 能不能审得准”而非具体条款颗粒度。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把公开法律条文与裁判文书做成可检索底座，让模型对具体条款输出带引用出处、可逐条核对的判断结果，而不是只给一段笼统的修改建议。
